summary: Garden maintenance yard by a gazebo on a pedestrian path; not a place to stay.
reasons: Garden service yard with work vehicles
Pedestrian path only, in public gardens

drivers.seclusion: Open lawns and paths of the Botanic Gardens, with a gazebo beside the pin; visitors pass constantly.
drivers.access_and_room: Wide path leads in, but it is a garden path with mapped bollards 134 m away and gates 156 m away; the small yard holds service vehicles.
drivers.traffic: Foot and cycle traffic only; little noise at night.
drivers.convention: Only garden work vehicles seen; no campervans or tyre tracks from visitors.
